name: Ice Cream Sandwich
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 80 g (2.8 oz / ⅔ stick) unsalted butter
125 g (4.4 oz / ⅝ cup) superfine sugar
180 g (6.3 oz / 1¼ cups) plain flour, plus extra for dusting
20 g (0.71 oz / 1 heaped tbsp) cocoa powder

steps: Mix the flour, cocoa, bicarbonate of soda, and salt in a bowl.
Beat the butter and sugar in a mixing bowl until soft and fluffy.
Fold the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients, and bring together until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2 minutes on a floured surface until smooth.
Shape the dough into a flat disc.
Cover with cling film and chill for 30 minutes.
Cover 2 baking trays with baking paper.
Roll out the dough to 5 mm thick.
Cut out into 24 circles, and arrange on the baking trays.
Place the biscuits on a wire rack and leave to cool.
Scoop 1 scoop of ice cream on a biscuit.
Repeat steps 15–16, using remaining biscuits and ice cream.

culture.text: An ice cream sandwich is a type of ice cream novelty sold and eaten in many countries. An ice cream sandwich consists of ice cream of varying flavors sandwiched between two pieces of a bread-like substance, such as bread, wafers, cookies, etc. Sold in grocery stores, ice cream parlors, and by street vendors, ice cream sandwiches have been utilized for their convenience. The agent acting as bread serves as an edible container for the ice cream -- similar to a cone. Ice cream sandwiches are typically referred to as an ice cream sandwich, although other names also exist, such as hokey pokey, or cream-between.
